description.zh: 磁盘ID。取值可以由多个磁盘ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The IDs of the disks. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 disk IDs. Separate multiple disk IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
磁盘类型。可能值：

- System：系统盘。

- Data：数据盘。

默认全量查询
description.en:
The disk type. Valid values:

- system: system disk

- data: data disk

By default, system disks and data disks are both queried.

description.zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the simple application server.

description.zh:
磁盘列表的页码。

默认值：1

分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100

默认值：10
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.
The region ID of the disks.
The ID of the resource group.
The tags that are added to the disks.

description.zh: 磁盘的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20。
description.en: The tag key. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

description.zh: 磁盘的标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20。
description.en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

title.zh: 查询一个或多个磁盘信息

descriptions.zh: `InstanceId`、`DiskIds`和`ResourceGroupId`不是必需的请求参数，但是可以构建过滤器逻辑，参数之间为逻辑与（And）关系。
descriptions.en: The `InstanceId`, `DiskIds`, and `ResourceGroupId` parameters are optional. However, you can specify them as filter conditions and combine them with the logical AND operator to filter disks that you want to query.
